name: Vil
about: Vil is Febric and Hreda's father and part of the co-family that shares child-raising with Gladias and Seila. The book does not describe his appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: their co-family, Uncle Vil and Aunt Daia
facts.fact: Co-family with Gladias and Seila; called Uncle Vil.

facts.quote: I lost my job at Jump because they went bankrupt
facts.fact: Lost his job and pursues a lawsuit against his former employer.

facts.quote: I'll take you on my next trip up to Northglade
Vil opened the door for him, and then sat back down in his chair.
facts.fact: Seen at home in his chair.

descriptor: a broad-shouldered man in his mid-forties, tall and heavyset, fair ruddy skin, close-cropped thinning ash-blond hair and a full sandy beard with laugh lines around the eyes, wearing a chunky oatmeal knitted sweater, brown canvas work trousers and sturdy hiking boots
